name: DiaHalu
description: DiaHalu is the first dialogue-level hallucination evaluation benchmark designed to measure hallucination in large language models across multi-turn dialogues. It covers four dialogue domains and five hallucination subtypes, including factuality and faithfulness hallucinations, with samples annotated by professional scholars.
reputation: A recent benchmark for dialogue-level hallucination that has gained attention in LLM evaluation, especially for multi-turn faithfulness and factuality analysis.
notes: Focuses on dialogue-level hallucination including both factuality and faithfulness; data generated via ChatGPT3.5 dialogues and manually refined.
